'''Chrona''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], near the [[Vaathkree Trade Corridor/Legends|Vaathkree Trade Corridor]]. [[Bantha/Legends|Banthas]] were raised and [[primacale]] crops were grown on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the final days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[chronamite]] was discovered on the planet.
